title: Universal Acoustic Adversarial Attacks for Flexible Control of Speech-LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the success of selective acoustic adversarial attacks that conditionally mute model outputs based on speaker gender (male vs. female), measured by comparing Word Error Rate (WER) and the percentage of muted samples between gender groups.

Evaluating the effectiveness of selective acoustic adversarial attacks designed to conditionally suppress model outputs based on the spoken language (e.g., English, French, Chinese), measured by Word Error Rate (WER) and muting success rates across different targeted language sets.
